import pandas as pd

# Read source CSV files with index_col=0 to ignore the numerical index column
source0 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/intermediate_space/length2_46/training_0.csv", index_col=0)
source1 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/intermediate_space/length2_46/training_1.csv", index_col=0)
source2 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/intermediate_space/length2_46/training_2.csv", index_col=0)

# All sources have the same schema as the target, so union them by concatenation
df = pd.concat([source0, source1, source2], ignore_index=True)

# Ensure correct dtypes as per target schema:
# ['adm0_name': string, 'adm1_name': string, 'mkt_name': string, 'cm_name': string,
#  'cur_name': string, 'pt_name': string, 'um_id': integer, 'um_name': string,
#  'mp_month': integer, 'mp_year': integer, 'mp_price': float]

# Convert columns to correct types explicitly
df['adm0_name'] = df['adm0_name'].astype(str)
df['adm1_name'] = df['adm1_name'].astype(str)
df['mkt_name'] = df['mkt_name'].astype(str)
df['cm_name'] = df['cm_name'].astype(str)
df['cur_name'] = df['cur_name'].astype(str)
df['pt_name'] = df['pt_name'].astype(str)
df['um_id'] = pd.to_numeric(df['um_id'], errors='coerce').fillna(0).astype(int)
df['um_name'] = df['um_name'].astype(str)
df['mp_month'] = pd.to_numeric(df['mp_month'], errors='coerce').fillna(0).astype(int)
df['mp_year'] = pd.to_numeric(df['mp_year'], errors='coerce').fillna(0).astype(int)
df['mp_price'] = pd.to_numeric(df['mp_price'], errors='coerce').astype(float)

# Save the final target table to the specified path
df.to_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length2_46/target_multisource.csv", index=False)
